title: Automatic bugs deduplicate by failure fingerprint
goal: backlog.py red-pipeline and the query-log revert compute a fingerprint of a failure (failed job, first failing test id or normalised first error line) and store it in the bug's links as 'fingerprint <12 hex>', the way 'pipeline <id>' is stored, with no new item field; when an open bug already carries the same fingerprint they add the new pipeline to that bug's links instead of filing another; tests.py -k fingerprint proves two red pipelines failing the same way give one bug and a different failure gives a second.

gates.question: This adds a mechanism before a failure it answers has happened (backlog.md, Changing this process). Add it anyway?
